gaps.lead: Someone stole her bike last week.
gaps.explanation: have something stolen/done = experience it happening to you.

gaps.lead: He began playing chess at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby or sport): took up chess.

gaps.lead: The doctor persuaded me to promise that I would exercise daily.
gaps.sentence: The doctor ___ that I would exercise daily.
gaps.explanation: get somebody TO do something = persuade/make them.

gaps.lead: The athlete insisted that she had never taken banned substances.
gaps.explanation: deny having + past participle denies an earlier action.

gaps.lead: The soup needed a little more salt.
gaps.explanation: needed a little more = didn't have enough (salt).

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly because he wanted us to understand him.
gaps.explanation: so that + subject + would/could expresses purpose.
